outOfScope: Choosing an optimization before consuming exact DONE BB-074 evidence.
Adding new product/runtime architecture, schedulers, context planes or evaluators to make a candidate possible.
Changing WHAT, acceptance semantics, benchmark task content, model/provider route, resource ceilings or product authority.
Executing any RELEASE_RESERVE model arm; BB-076 owns first use.
Treating this research allocation as implementation readiness or product delivery.
constraints: Worker execution requires exact DONE BB-074 and BB-059 bindings; incompatible delivered semantics yield PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
Candidate selection is deterministic from immutable BB-074 evidence and may choose at most one bounded HOW/configuration axis.
If no observed bottleneck maps to an already delivered safe HOW seam, the valid outcome is KEEP_BASELINE rather than source-scope expansion.
Improvement and release-reserve cohorts are disjoint from every task used/reserved by BB-065/077/081/074 and are sealed before candidate execution.
Quality remains independently evaluated; missing/unknown primary accounting remains unknown and cannot be zero-filled.
invariants: Application owns work semantics and domain authority; Oracle owns source IO; runtime success is not acceptance or publication authority.
Every result binds exact source, attempt, configuration and evidence; unknown effects or missing evidence cannot be called success.
The outer Blackboard schedules ExHarness development only; product runtime coordination remains a separate system.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Consume exact DONE BB-074 evidence plus exact DONE BB-059 HOW-evolution authority; do not preselect an optimization during research.

D2 — Run a deterministic HOW_IMPROVEMENT_SELECTION_V1 reducer. Eligible axes are STRATEGY_POLICY, CONTEXT_POLICY, TOOL_POLICY or NONE; only observed fingerprints addressable through delivered bounded HOW/config seams are eligible.

D3 — Selection precedence is: eligible critical lifecycle/recovery failure, repeated accepted-quality/failure fingerprint, repeated known-cost inefficiency, repeated prompt-input/model-turn inefficiency, then NONE. Within a class use affected registered-unit count then lexicographic fingerprint id.

D4 — Before candidate construction, exclude every task digest used/reserved by BB-065/077/081/074 from the pinned Terminal-Bench 2.1 pool, oracle-preflight 5/5 plus nop-fail 1/1, sort by immutable bundle digest, seal first six as IMPROVEMENT_HOLDOUT and next four as RELEASE_RESERVE.
D5 — BB-075 may execute only IMPROVEMENT_HOLDOUT. Any model execution over RELEASE_RESERVE before BB-076 invalidates the partition.

D6 — BASELINE is the exact supported BB-074/BB-081 profile with current HOW policy; CANDIDATE differs only by one immutable HOW_PROFILE_V1. Same task/prompt/environment/tools/model/provider/budgets/evaluator apply to both.
D7 — Run six tasks x two repeats x two arms = 24 registered arm units with counterbalanced order, fresh task/runtime/provider state and append-only attempt accounting.
D8 — Fingerprints map to one frozen primary metric family: FAILURE_RATE, PROVIDER_COST, PROMPT_INPUT or MODEL_TURNS. A fingerprint with no safe mapping is ineligible.

D9 — Promotion requires complete known primary evidence, no quality/safety/currentness regression and the metric-specific minimum effect; otherwise complete evidence yields KEEP_BASELINE and missing/drifted evidence yields INCONCLUSIVE.
D10 — Promotion uses BB-059 proposal/promoter/currentness semantics only. Existing attempts keep old bindings; rollback is a successor generation selecting an exact prior accepted profile.
D11 — BB-075 product/runtime source writes are forbidden. If a measured bottleneck needs a new implementation seam, record a follow-up research requirement and KEEP_BASELINE.
implementationSlices: S1 — Resolve exact DONE BB-074/059, recompute evidence identities and run deterministic HOW_IMPROVEMENT_SELECTION_V1. NONE immediately yields an evidence-backed KEEP_BASELINE path.

S2 — Build the prior-task exclusion set, run oracle/nop preflight on the remaining pinned Terminal-Bench 2.1 pool and seal six IMPROVEMENT_HOLDOUT plus four RELEASE_RESERVE tasks by digest order before candidate construction.

S3 — Materialize exactly one immutable HOW_PROFILE_V1 through an already delivered HOW/configuration seam and bind it to the selected fingerprint plus metric family. No package source implementation is allowed.
S4 — Execute all 24 registered BASELINE/CANDIDATE held-out arm units with fixed factors, fresh state and complete append-only attempt/provider accounting.
S5 — Run the frozen reducer for PROMOTE_CANDIDATE|KEEP_BASELINE|INCONCLUSIVE. PROMOTE uses BB-059 proposal/promoter/currentness; KEEP leaves current policy unchanged.
S6 — Publish selection/cohort/attempt/report/decision evidence, update Living truth and hand the unopened RELEASE_RESERVE manifest to BB-076.

negativeVerificationCases: Operator-picked candidate not produced by HOW_IMPROVEMENT_SELECTION_V1.
Provider 429/timeout classified as product HOW defect.
Candidate changes evaluator, task content, model/provider route or resource budget.
Candidate requires packages/** mutation but Worker proceeds instead of KEEP_BASELINE.
Prior benchmark task appears in IMPROVEMENT_HOLDOUT or RELEASE_RESERVE.
Any RELEASE_RESERVE model result exists before BB-076.
Unknown primary metric represented as zero or used to promote.
Accepted-quality or critical-safety regression hidden by efficiency gain.
Existing active attempt rebound to newly promoted policy.
Stale promotion head mutates current policy.

laneContracts.input: exact READY plan + DONE direct dependencies
laneContracts.convergence: all acceptance claims SATISFIED + evaluated source merged

livingDocs.statement: BB-075 Living truth describes only the implemented and independently verified supported capability and limitations.

selectionContract.input: exact DONE BB-074 report + unit/attempt evidence
selectionContract.repeated: at least two distinct registered units, except one BB-074 primary critical lifecycle gate failure with unambiguous HOW ownership
forbidden: provider availability as product HOW defect

cohortContract.exclude: all task digests used or reserved by BB-065, BB-077, BB-081 and BB-074
cohortContract.preflight: Harbor oracle 5/5 and nop fail >=1/1 before candidate live execution
cohortContract.mutationRule: after any candidate live run, cohort and reserve are immutable
cohortContract.reserveRule: BB-075 must not execute model arms on RELEASE_RESERVE

arms.BASELINE: supported BB-074/BB-081 profile + current HOW policy

evaluationContract.fresh: task environment + runtime state + provider session per registered arm unit
evaluationContract.attempts: append-only; retries never overwrite prior attempts

metricContract.FAILURE_RATE: fewer target-fingerprint attempts, eliminate at least two matched baseline occurrences, candidate accepted quality >= baseline, no new critical fingerprint, recovery/currentness negatives pass
metricContract.PROVIDER_COST: median cost ratio <=0.90 with known cost, accepted quality >= baseline, turns ratio <=1.00, no new critical fingerprint
metricContract.PROMPT_INPUT: median prompt-input ratio <=0.90, accepted quality >= baseline, known cost ratio <=1.10 when available, no new critical fingerprint
metricContract.MODEL_TURNS: median turn ratio <=0.90, accepted quality >= baseline, known cost ratio <=1.10 when available, no new critical fingerprint

decisionContract.promote: complete 24-unit cohort + known primary metric + all quality/safety/currentness gates + selected minimum effect
decisionContract.keep: complete valid evidence and selection NONE, unavailable bounded seam, insufficient effect or conclusive regression
decisionContract.inconclusive: missing unit, unknown primary metric, verifier/task/profile drift or incomplete required negative evidence
decisionContract.authority: frozen deterministic reducer; Jev validates evidence claims and cannot rewrite outcome

dependencyResolution.workerStart: Resolve exact DONE BB-059 implementation-result/judgment/Living refs and the delivered HOW-evolution export. The research baseline does not require future BB-059 source files to exist.
dependencyResolution.contradiction: Missing or incompatible delivered HOW-evolution seam => PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
